# statuspage_incident (Resource)

Manages a Statuspage incident.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statuspage_incident" "outage" {
  page_id         = "abc123def456"
  name            = "API Degraded Performance"
  status          = "investigating"
  body            = "We are currently investigating degraded API performance."
  impact_override = "minor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Incident name.
- `page_id` (String)

### Optional

- `auto_transition_deliver_notifications_at_end` (Boolean)
- `auto_transition_deliver_notifications_at_start` (Boolean)
- `auto_transition_to_maintenance_state` (Boolean)
- `auto_transition_to_operational_state` (Boolean)
- `auto_tweet_at_beginning` (Boolean)
- `auto_tweet_on_completion` (Boolean)
- `auto_tweet_on_creation` (Boolean)
- `auto_tweet_one_hour_before` (Boolean)
- `body` (String) The initial message, created as the first incident update.
- `component_ids` (List of String)
- `components` (Map of String) Map of component IDs to their status.
- `deliver_notifications` (Boolean)
- `impact_override` (String)
- `scheduled_auto_completed` (Boolean)
- `scheduled_auto_in_progress` (Boolean)
- `scheduled_for` (String) The timestamp the maintenance is scheduled for (ISO 8601).
- `scheduled_remind_prior` (Boolean)
- `scheduled_until` (String) The timestamp the maintenance is scheduled until (ISO 8601).
- `status` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `shortlink` (String)
